svg.title: Threat model
svg.desc: Five attackers, what each can and cannot do, and the mitigations from the security review, with the deployer key as residual trust.
svg.text: Threat model, by who holds what
Ids refer to findings in docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md. Every Critical and High item is fixed with a regression test.
keep the vault Alive while the key
move funds or change the plan
exceed policy or pay the contract
pay once a beat is missed
denials return a reason and are
residual: spend up to the daily
choose when to poke and step
relay late, or not at all
front-run step III with poor chain
pick the EVM nonce (C-1) or exceed
contract builds the tx; nonce is
edit the plan, as owner, while
use the seller's pulse or agent
a key whose AddKey lands late is
poke after the deadline, earn the
one re-sign in flight per payout
The deployer FullAccess key can redeploy the contract and so move any vault (I-1). Mainnet: remove the key or gate upgrades behind a DAO.
Also: a Solana payout already signed can only be re-signed by the owner or keeper (M-3). Not audited.
Each key is a NEAR function-call access key on the contract's own account, scoped to one method.
